svg.title: Fan-out on write versus fan-out on read
svg.desc: Left: one post by A is inserted into each of its 200 followers' feeds, and a feed load reads one list. Right: a post is written once, and each feed load looks up 200 authors. Per day at this scale: 10 billion inserts plus 5 billion reads, against 50 million writes plus 1 trillion lookups.
svg.text: per day at 50M posts, 5B feed loads, 200 followers each
